FlexAI

Software Engineer, New Grad

Software Engineer, New Grad
About FlexAI

Build and Deploy AI the right way, anywhere. 

The FlexAI Compute Infrastructure Platform provides an "end-to-end AI compute layer" for running and managing workloads across any cloud, any GPU, and any deployment model (public, hybrid, or on-prem). It brings together "1-click simplicity" for users with "enterprise-grade orchestration, security, and automation" under the hood.

Founded by Brijesh Tripathi, who brings experience from Nvidia, Apple, Tesla, Intel and Zoox, FlexAI is not just building a product – we’re shaping the future of AI. Our teams are strategically distributed across Silicon Valley and Bengaluru, united by a shared mission: to deliver more compute with less complexity.

 If you're passionate about shaping the future of artificial intelligence, driving innovation, and contributing to a sustainable and inclusive AI ecosystem, FlexAI is the place for you !

Role Overview

FlexAI is looking for a Software Engineer (New Grad) to join our engineering team and help build the next generation of AI infrastructure.

From day one, you’ll work on real product features that impact customers — not sandbox projects. You’ll collaborate closely with a small, experienced team and learn by building across a wide range of technical challenges.

We move fast and value engineers who are curious, proactive, and excited to take ownership — with strong mentorship and support to help you grow quickly.

What You'll Do
Design and build highly reliable, resilient infrastructure products and features
Work closely with developers, product, and customer-facing teams to solve real problems
Write high-quality, extensible, and maintainable code
Design and build APIs to drive existing and new platform features
Build solutions with a high level of reliability, scalability, and security
Debug issues and improve system performance
0-to-1 creation: Rapidly iterate — from idea to deployment
Take ownership of features and drive them to completion
What You'll Need to Be Successful
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
At least one internship — ideally in a high-growth startup or infrastructure environment
Strong coding ability in at least one language such as Python, Go, Java, or Javascript
Experience using AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, Others)
Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and writing efficient, scalable code
Familiarity with web applications or API development
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to learn quickly and operate with increasing independence
Clear communication and ability to collaborate across teams
Contributions to open source, hackathons, or shipped side projects is a plus
What We Offer
A competitive salary and benefits package
Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure
Build products used by developers and enterprises
High ownership, fast execution, real impact
Collaborative, high-caliber team

The pay range for this role is:

100,000 - 150,000 USD per year (US)
